SELECT V.* FROM ( SELECT a.ID AS id,CONCAT(a.DATASOURCE_NAME,'(', a.TYPE,')') AS lable,'' AS "pId",'source' AS "nodeType" FROM seo.seo_datasource a
EXISTS(SELECT SOURCE_ID FROM edw.fm_trs_guoku_base_table WHERE a.ID=SOURCE_ID AND STATE IN('0','1') AND TABLE_ID IS NOT NULL AND
(TABLE_SIGN LIKE '%${tableName}%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%${tableName}%')
)
UNION SELECT b.ID AS id,b.DBNAME AS lable, b.SOURCE_ID AS "pId",'database' AS "nodeType" FROM seo.seo_datasource_database b JOIN seo.seo_datasource a ON a.ID = b.SOURCE_ID WHERE b.STATE = '0'
AND EXISTS(SELECT DATABASE_ID FROM edw.fm_trs_guoku_base_table WHERE b.ID=DATABASE_ID AND STATE IN('0','1') AND TABLE_ID IS NOT NULL AND
(TABLE_SIGN LIKE '%${tableName}%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%${tableName}%')
)
UNION SELECT DISTINCT r.TABLE_ID AS id,CONCAT(r.TABLE_SIGN, '(', r.TABLE_NAME, ')▲',CASE WHEN STATE='0' THEN '启用' ELSE '停用' END) AS lable,r.DATABASE_ID AS "pId",'table' AS "nodeType" FROM edw.fm_trs_guoku_base_table r WHERE r.STATE IN('0','1') AND r.TABLE_ID IS NOT NULL
AND
(r.TABLE_SIGN LIKE '%${tableName}%' OR r.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%${tableName}%')
) V

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT r.TABLE_ID AS id,CONCAT(r.TABLE_SIGN, '(', r.TABLE_NAME, ')') AS lable,r.DATABASE_ID AS "pId" FROM edw.fm_trs_guoku_base_table r WHERE r.STATE = '0' AND r.DATABASE_ID = #{params.parentId} ) v where 1=1
AND
v.lable LIKE '%${tableName}%'

SELECT r.*,CONCAT(a.DATASOURCE_NAME,'(', a.TYPE,')') AS "DATASOURCE_NAME",b.DBNAME AS "DBNAME" FROM edw.fm_trs_guoku_base_table r LEFT JOIN seo.seo_datasource a ON a.ID = r.SOURCE_ID LEFT JOIN seo.seo_datasource_database b ON b.ID = r.DATABASE_ID WHERE r.TABLE_ID = #{params.TABLE_ID}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM edw.fm_trs_guoku_base_table r WHERE r.SOURCE_ID = #{params.SOURCE_ID} AND r.DATABASE_ID = #{params.DATABASE_ID} AND r.TABLE_SIGN = #{params.TABLE_SIGN}
